messages.subject: 64-bit Windows
messages.body_plain:
Hi all,

Are there any instructions for running on a 64 bit R install on 64 bit
windows?  Eg. which GTK install, etc?

Kind Regards
Shane

messages.subject: Re: 64-bit Windows
messages.body_plain:
Hi Shane,

I've done only a little testing under MS/Windows 7 (64 bit) using the
pre-release of R 2.12.0. There is to be a new release of RGtk2 which
is using newer Gtk+ to come out with 2.12.0.

I installed

http://downloads.sourceforge.net/gtk-win/gtk2-runtime-2.16.6-2010-02-24-ash.exe

and that works on the 32bit R that R2.12.0 installs, but not for the
64bit R that comes in the same package.

I've yet to find (though only superficially searched for) a 64 bit
version of Gtk+ and suspect that is the issue. RGtk2 installs but
complains about not finding linintl-8.dll. If anyone is aware of a 64
bit Gtl+ for MS/Windows please let me know. I'm aware of
http://www.gtk.org/download-windows-64bit.html but not a simple self
extracting installer yet.

Regards,
Graham
